summary: Frontend-only testing complete for PhD Compass mobile app. All 24 features tested and working correctly. No backend APIs (fully client-side with AsyncStorage). Tested: welcome modal, 5-tab navigation, journal entry with tags, progress tracking with milestones/courses, review system with pillar scorecard, SOPs management, vision planning, settings with theme toggle, and dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - not critical, just a deprecation warning from React Native
All React Native best practices followed: View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput used correctly
All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
Mobile-first design with proper touch targets (44px+ height)
Text contrast is good in both light and dark modes
No HTML elements used (proper React Native components only)
AsyncStorage used correctly for client-side data persistence
seed_data_creation: Default data initialized on first load: 11 milestones, 7 SOPs, 3 courses (via initializeDefaults() in storage.ts)
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a fully client-side Expo/React Native app with no backend. All data stored in AsyncStorage (browser localStorage on web). App loads correctly at https://phd-compass.preview.emergentagent.com. Welcome modal appears on first load and can be dismissed. All 5 tabs navigate correctly. All features tested and working: journal entries with pillar/skill tags, progress tracking with milestones/courses, weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews with pillar scorecard, SOPs with categories and steps, vision planning with identity gaps and pillar references, settings with theme toggle and backup/restore. Dark mode works correctly. No issues found.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. All features working as expected.
